exactQuestion: What is the deadline for filing the quarterly percentage tax return?
publicAnswer:
### Short Answer
The deadline for filing the quarterly percentage tax return (BIR Form 2551Q) is on or before the 25th day of the month following the end of each taxable quarter.

### Controlling Authorities
This is established under Section 116 of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), which outlines the imposition of percentage tax and the requirement to file returns.

### Interpretation
Section 116 of the NIRC specifies that taxpayers liable for percentage tax must file their returns quarterly. The due date for these returns is set to ensure timely reporting and payment of the tax due for the preceding quarter.

### Practical Meaning
Taxpayers must be diligent in filing their quarterly percentage tax returns by the 25th day of the month following the end of each quarter to avoid penalties and interest on late payments. This compliance is crucial for maintaining good standing with the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) and avoiding any potential legal issues related to tax obligations.
